They stand in front of a massive, ornate fairytale castle with colorful spires under a bright, overcast sky. They begin by holding hands and performing a synchronized jump followed by rhythmic arm waving. (2) The scene cuts to a different park area with whimsical, multicolored buildings and a 'Magic Land' sign in the background. The women perform a repetitive dance move involving shaking their hands near their chests and twisting their hips. Their facial expressions are joyful with wide smiles and focused eyes. (3) The visual returns to the castle backdrop. The four women continue their choreography, raising their arms high in the air and stepping in place. Background tourists are visible leaning on a brown wooden fence behind the dancers. The lighting remains flat and natural. (4) The final phase returns to the colorful architectural background. The women transition into a lower pose, forming hand hearts and smiling directly at the camera to conclude the routine. Their hand movements are precise and synchronized.
